text: Perhaps I shall have to change, however; to do something else. I’ve no longer myself to think of. My daughter’s growing up and may very possibly not care so much for the Correggios and crucifixes as I. I shall have to do what’s best for Pansy.” “Yes, do that,” said Isabel. “She’s such a dear little girl.” “Ah,” cried Gilbert Osmond beautifully, “she’s a little saint of heaven! She is my great happiness!” While this sufficiently intimate colloquy (prolonged for some time after we cease to follow it) went forward Madame Merle and her companion, breaking a silence of some duration, had begun to exchange remarks.
